attributes.action: Require the Government to Reform Fixed-Rate Mortgages and Protect Homeowners!
attributes.additional_details: Homeowners pass strict affordability checks, yet when their fixed mortgage rate expires, repayments can rise dramatically despite no change in their circumstances. Families who have paid every instalment on time can be forced to sell their homes. The Government should reform mortgage rules to provide long-term rate security, protect against sudden repayment increases and let homeowners benefit when interest rates fall.
attributes.background: Require the Government to review and reform the UK mortgage system to provide homeowners with greater long-term interest-rate security and protection against unaffordable repayment increases when fixed-rate deals expire.

rejection.details:
We are not clear what action you would like the Government as part of such a reform, or what way you would like home owners to be protected. 

You can submit a new petition setting out more clearly what action you are seeking from the Government, or to call for a review, if you would like.
